_설명: 영어 원문 → 인도네시아어 번역 짝 규칙 (2026-11-10, 몽골 장편 1·2편 대조에서 찾음). 원문(src)과 번역문(tgt)이 같은 묶음에서 둘 다 맞을 때만 걸린다. 한 언어 규칙은 id.rules.json. scripts/check-lines.py가 씀, 시험: check-lines.py --selftest

rules.msg: "today's X / what is now X"를 "X sekarang"으로 직역 - 인니어로는 "지금의 X"보다 "지금(그때) X가"로 읽혀 시점이 흐려짐 (1·2편 실제)
rules.natural: wilayah yang kini jadi Tiongkok utara / Iran masa kini
bad: the huge Jin Empire held what is now northern China.
Kekaisaran Jin menguasai Tiongkok utara sekarang.
stretching from today's Uzbekistan to Iran.
dari Uzbekistan sampai Iran sekarang.
good: the huge Jin Empire held what is now northern China.
Kekaisaran Jin menguasai wilayah yang kini jadi Tiongkok utara.
They had modern weapons by now.
Jenghis sekarang punya senjata baru.
stretching from today's Uzbekistan to Iran.
dari Uzbekistan sampai Iran masa kini.

rules.msg: "unseen by any city" 직역 - "tak terlihat satu kota pun"은 "(군대가) 도시를 하나도 못 봤다"로 읽혀 주어가 뒤집힘
rules.natural: tanpa terlihat dari kota mana pun / tanpa ketahuan satu kota pun
bad: slipped into the desert, unseen by any city,
menyelinap ke gurun, tak terlihat satu kota pun,
good: slipped into the desert, unseen by any city,
menyelinap ke gurun tanpa terlihat dari kota mana pun,

rules.msg: "These two had history" 직역 - "punya sejarah"는 "역사가 있다(유서 깊다)"로 읽혀 "얽힌 악연"이라는 뜻이 사라짐
rules.natural: Dua orang ini sudah lama berselisih / punya dendam lama
bad: These two had history, you see.
Dua orang ini punya sejarah.
good: These two had history, you see.
Dua orang ini ternyata punya dendam lama.

rules.msg: "secure his back" 직역 - "mengamankan punggungnya"는 몸의 등을 지킨다는 말로 읽힘 (군사 뜻 아님)
rules.natural: memastikan tak ada ancaman dari belakang / mengamankan sisi belakangnya
bad: Genghis had to secure his back.
Jenghis harus mengamankan punggungnya.
good: Genghis had to secure his back.
Jenghis harus memastikan tak ada ancaman dari belakang.

rules.msg: "the Mongol invasion of the Jin"을 "Invasi Jin"·"Invasi Mongol"로 줄임 - 인니어 "Invasi X"는 X가 친 쪽으로 읽힘. 누가 누구를 쳤는지 "ke"로 둘 다 밝힘 (2026-10 실제 사고)
bad: The Mongol invasion of the Jin, part one.
Invasi Jin, bagian 1.
The Mongol invasion of the Jin, part one.
Invasi Mongol 1.
good: The Mongol invasion of the Jin, part one.
Invasi Mongol ke Jin, bagian 1.
The Mongol invasion of the Jin, continues in part two.
Invasi Mongol ke Xia Barat ke Jin, berlanjut di bagian 2.

rules.msg: "a future enemy" 직역 - "musuh masa depan"은 "미래(먼 훗날)의 적"처럼 들림, 인니어는 "calon"
bad: Genghis Khan marked one as a future enemy.
satu ditandai Jenghis Khan sebagai musuh masa depan.
good: Genghis Khan marked one as a future enemy.
Jenghis Khan menandai satu calon musuh.

rules.msg: 영어 분사구 문두 "Blamed for ..., the emperor"를 "Disalahkan karena ...,"로 그대로 - 인니어 말로는 주어 먼저 또는 "Karena"
rules.natural: Karena dianggap gagal ..., sang kaisar ... / Sang kaisar disalahkan karena ..., lalu digulingkan
bad: Blamed for failing to stop the Mongols, the emperor was overthrown by his own cousin.
Disalahkan karena gagal menahan Mongol, sang kaisar digulingkan sepupunya sendiri.
good: Blamed for failing to stop the Mongols, the emperor was overthrown by his own cousin.
Sang kaisar dianggap gagal menahan Mongol, lalu digulingkan sepupunya sendiri.
Blamed for failing, the emperor fell.
Di depan tembok, sang kaisar jatuh.
Indeed, the Jin were strong.
Ternyata, Jin memang kuat.

rules.msg: "Desperate, Xia begged" / "In a panic, the garrison" 직역 - 감정 형용사 한 낱말 + 쉼표 문두는 영어 꼴
rules.natural: Karena putus asa, Xia ... / Xia yang terdesak pun ... / Pasukan kota panik dan ...
bad: Desperate, Xia begged the Jin for help.
Putus asa, Xia memohon bantuan Jin.
In a panic, the garrison tried to slip out.
Panik, pasukan kota mencoba menyelinap keluar.
good: Desperate, Xia begged the Jin for help.
Karena terdesak, Xia memohon bantuan Jin.
In a panic, the garrison tried to slip out.
Pasukan kota panik dan mencoba menyelinap keluar.

rules.msg: "The Jin, founded by ..." 명사 + 쉼표 + 분사 조각 직역 - 인니어는 "yang"으로 잇거나 문장으로
rules.natural: Ada Jin, yang didirikan bangsa Jurchen. / Jin didirikan oleh bangsa Jurchen.
bad: The Jin, founded by the Jurchen people.
Jin, didirikan bangsa Jurchen.
The Song, pushed by the Jin down to the Yangtze.
Song, didesak Jin sampai ke Yangtze.
good: The Jin, founded by the Jurchen people.
Ada Jin, yang didirikan bangsa Jurchen.
The Song, pushed by the Jin down to the Yangtze.
Lalu Song, yang didesak Jin sampai ke Yangtze.

rules.msg: "Step one: / One: ... Two:" 직역 - 인니어는 서수 (pertama, kedua)
bad: Step one: find a guide.
Langkah satu: cari pemandu.
One: the Jin had backed the Tatars.
Satu: Jin pernah mendukung Tatar.
good: Step one: find a guide.
Langkah pertama: cari pemandu.
One: the Jin had backed the Tatars.
Pertama, Jin pernah mendukung Tatar.

rules.msg: "settled state / settled people" 직역 - "negara yang menetap"은 나라가 한곳에 '머문다'는 뜻이 됨
rules.natural: negara agraris / negara petani / bangsa yang hidup menetap
bad: he'd never really gone up against a settled state.
belum pernah benar-benar melawan negara yang menetap.
a town built by settled people
kota buatan bangsa menetap
good: he'd never really gone up against a settled state.
belum pernah benar-benar melawan negara agraris.
a town built by settled people
kota buatan bangsa yang hidup menetap

rules.msg: 영어 perfect를 "sempurna"로 그대로 - "흠 없이 완벽한"이라 과장, 말로는 "pas"·"cocok"·"ideal"
rules.natural: pas sekali / cocok / ideal / paling ampuh
bad: That made it the perfect dress rehearsal for the Jin.
Xia jadi ajang latihan sempurna sebelum Jin.
the perfect defense against Mongol horsemen.
pertahanan sempurna melawan penunggang kuda Mongol.
good: That made it the perfect dress rehearsal for the Jin.
Xia pas sekali jadi ajang latihan sebelum Jin.
the perfect defense against Mongol horsemen.
pertahanan yang ideal melawan penunggang kuda Mongol.

rules.msg: 영어 수동 "was powered by"를 "di- ... oleh"로 그대로 - oleh를 빼거나 행위자를 주어로
rules.natural: Ketapel ini ditarik tenaga orang / Mongol menghancurkan kota itu
bad: These catapults were powered by people pulling ropes.
Ketapel ini digerakkan oleh orang-orang yang menarik tali.
good: These catapults were powered by people pulling ropes.
Ketapel ini digerakkan tenaga orang yang menarik tali.

rules.msg: 영어 "So how, / did ..."의 끊김을 그대로 옮겨 의문사 뒤에 쉼표 - 인니어는 의문사와 문장을 붙여 읽음
bad: So how, did Genghis Khan get ready for a war with the Jin?
Jadi bagaimana, Jenghis Khan bersiap perang melawan Jin?
good: So how, did Genghis Khan get ready for a war with the Jin?
Jadi, bagaimana Jenghis Khan bersiap perang melawan Jin?

rules.msg: 사람(특히 황제)이 병 · 노환으로 "died"를 "mati"로 - 짐승에 쓰는 거친 말, 황제는 "wafat", 사람은 "meninggal" (싸움에서는 "tewas")
bad: But then Zhangzong died with no heir.
Tapi lalu Zhangzong mati tanpa pewaris.
good: But then Zhangzong died with no heir.
Tapi lalu Zhangzong wafat tanpa pewaris.
The prince was so angry he wanted Genghis dead.
Sang pangeran begitu marah sampai ingin Jenghis mati.

rules.msg: "The message they sent was a threat" 직역 - "yang ... adalah"는 영어 was를 그대로 옮긴 글말, 말로는 쌍점 · -lah · 바로 서술
rules.natural: Pesannya jelas: ancaman. / Yang pertama berangkat: 20.000 penunggang kuda
bad: The message they sent was a threat.
Pesan yang mereka kirim adalah ancaman.
good: The message they sent was a threat.
Pesannya jelas: ancaman.
